caption: The drawing depicts a wooden figure resembling a soldier or guard in a red jacket with gold buttons, blue pants, and black boots, standing upright on a circular base. The figure's arms are extended horizontally to the sides and are jointed at the shoulders; each arm holds a long spear with a pointed tip. The face is roughly shaped and painted with simple facial features, and the head is topped with a black conical hat. The figure’s torso is red, while the lower body, legs, and arms are shades of blue and brown. The background is plain and unadorned, and the object is centered on the paper. The overall color palette includes red, blue, brown, black, gray, and muted tones.
title: Whirligig
